files.description: The rules of the repository: what the page is, its layout, the rules it follows, how it is checked, the workflow, the writing style, how it moves independently of sqzer-dev/sqzer
What the page is, how to run it, how the version of sqzer is bumped, how a browser is checked
The index of design and behaviour decisions, and which decisions taken in sqzer-dev/sqzer govern this page

The design of the page: the drop zone as the empty state, the image on the whole screen under glass panels, the target first and every package option behind Advanced, untouched controls sending nothing, the search shown as it runs, the result as size, difference and chips, errors as alerts, the privacy claim, the wordmark, the accessibility floor
The message protocol between the page and the worker, at the top of the file, and how the package version is read
